messages.subject: Global Mining Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Rocco Mercier Team,

Your exclusive focus on executive search across the global mining and minerals sector makes this a particularly relevant introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major gold-mining operation. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where mining strategy depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline, responsible development and coordinated execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
